sections.value:
Security PASS, FINAL C34 round 2, for #297 at 519843289b4c8eeb068cb9d96ab9e16f392b26d3.

No security vulnerabilities found. The round-1 stamp note is closed within C33's user-account trust boundary. No new issue requires a pm-001 ruling or a third review round.

| # | Severity | File | Lines | Vulnerability | Confidence |
|---|----------|------|-------|---------------|------------|
| - | - | - | - | None found | - |

Closure evidence:
- harness/scripts/shared-build.sh:375-382: the shared writer rejects a final symlink/directory, creates an exclusive temporary file with /usr/bin/mktemp inside the target, writes literal content, renames it, and removes its temporary file on failure. Both running (394) and finished (430) publication call this writer.
- shared-build.sh:384-392: reads require a regular, non-symlink stamp; read -r and quoted comparison keep stamp content inert. Missing/rejected stamps and legacy/running values conservatively cause source touching. A planted file symlink, directory symlink or ordinary directory is not written through; repeated runs remain conservative.
- shared-build.sh:373-374 explicitly discloses the check-before-rename window. This is not a race-free guarantee against a hostile same-user process; that residual is accepted by C33. The cheap planted-path safeguards remain present.
- The unchanged mkdir -m 0700 lock at shared-build.sh:314/321 encloses stamp handling, cargo and copy-out (431-436). Argument serialization and the cargo/drain loop are unchanged.
- harness/scripts/shared-build.test.ts:303-320 exercises a directory-symlink destination twice, verifies conservative touches, an untouched destination, a preserved symlink and no temporary leftovers. Lines 322-378 cover failed batches, target-triple layout, non-deps artifacts, legacy-stamp adoption and newer target-triple deps.

Validation:
- Initial and immediately pre-publication just pr-freeze 297: FINAL, exact full head above, merge CLEAN, clean detached worktree, latest five checks passed.
- CI run 44780085069: exact head verified, success. shared-build.test.ts 26/26; TypeScript total 2385 passed, 7 skipped; Rust total 2689 passed, 6 skipped. Typecheck and lint commands exited successfully; lint retained a schema info and an existing release-build test warning.
- Successful rust-test job 136440126653 uploaded JUnit artifact 14650689845: independently checked build_stamps 14/14, no errors/failures/skips, including both F244 bounce-refusal cases.
- Security agent locally ran Bash syntax and git diff --check against the previous reviewed head: exit 0. Its two niced, memory-only Python/Bash probes passed 25 assertions covering writer branches, literal content, read/comparison behavior, unchanged serialization/order and twice-repeated directory/file-symlink fallback behavior. Mutating utilities were mocked: this is not an actual rename integration test or a live daemon bounce.
- Round-2 fixes add no dependencies or lockfile changes. The merged main change to crates/testkit/Cargo.toml only declares the #295 fixture-sweep binary. Added-line screening found no secret/private-path pattern matches; no credential files were read.
- harness boot: advisory ready:false because this read-only worktree has no node_modules. C25 keeps TypeScript test proof in exact-head CI; no packages were installed or borrowed.
- NPM_CONFIG_OFFLINE=true NPM_CONFIG_YES=false CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 harness checks: exit 1. Local Rust (fmt/clippy/tests), route-inventory, smoke, pij-skill, native Copilot contracts and SDK contracts passed. Eight dependency-dependent stages failed in this dependency-free worktree: local-paths, omp-config, ddocs, coverage, typecheck, lockfile, lint and test. Logs show missing local tsx/vitest and an incompatible ambient Biome configuration; attribution also warned because local tsx is absent. This is not a green local full gate. No package acquisition occurred; exact-head CI is the C25 TypeScript proof.

Harness feedback: the no-finding security-agent response dropped its scoped closure evidence, requiring an extra handoff. Captured as security-297-r2/DL-001; the encodable improvement is to preserve exact-head closure references and executed-check results in that response contract. No repository source edits were made.

Holding security/297 is retained until merge.
